notes.title: First Big Update is now Live!
notes.content:
[u][b]Visual Overhaul & Gameplay Improvements[/b][/u]
Hey everyone! We’ve rolled out a fresh update over the weekend packed with changes to make your experience even better. This update focuses on a slick visual overhaul, smoother movement, and smarter enemies—plus some level tweaks to keep you on edge. Here’s what’s new:

[b]Visual Overhaul[/b]: Revamped the body cam perspective for a more immersive feel—everything looks sharper and more intense!

 [b]Smoother Player Movement[/b]: Fixed the glitch where arms awkwardly pulled away from the camera. Movement is now fluid and natural.

[b]Player Speed Boost[/b]: Increased movement speed for a snappier pace. Sprinting backwards is disabled—look behind you at your own risk!

 [b]Level Enhancements[/b]: All four levels got some love:
  - Tightened level design for less open space and more tension.
  - Added new events to boost immersion and keep you guessing.

 [b]Audio Upgrade[/b]: 
  -Replaced some in game sounds for more immersion and keep players on their feet.

 [b]Enemy Improvements[/b]: 
  - Enemies now seek shelter when under fire, but watch out—they might come back stronger with extra health!
  - Fixed sliding issues during attacks for more realistic behavior.

We’re excited to announce two new levels in the works—one featuring a brand-new game mode to shake things up! And even though this game was always Single Player focused we’re seriously considering a multiplayer mode down the road. Stay tuned for more!!

notes.title: Upcoming Update!
notes.content:
[b]Hey everyone,
[/b]
I’ve been reading all your feedback and watching the gameplay videos. I have been working on improving Menticide! The most noticeable changes in the upcoming update will be:

[b]Visual Overhaul[/b] – Tweaking the visuals to enhance the bodycam feel.

[b]Level Design Improvements[/b] – Adjusting layouts for better pacing and atmosphere.

[b]Bug Fixes/Gameplay Enhancements [/b]– Fixed that annoying issue where the player's arms would glitch forward. Gameplay improvements that make character movement quicker and smoother.

[b]Enemy AI Rework[/b] – Still rebuilding enemy AI to make encounters more dynamic. This may take a bit longer, but I’ll continue working on it!

And on top of that, I’m also working on a [b]new level[/b] and a [b]new game mode[/b], which I’ll share more details on soon.

Thanks for all the support—excited to show you what’s next! This is a passion project, and as I continue to improve as a developer, the game will only improve along the way.

notes.title: Menticide Update patch notes
notes.content:
**Gameplay Improvements:**

- Fixed AI behavior to ensure they return to patrol routes after disengaging from chasing the player, such as when the player moves out of detection range or breaks line of sight.
- Increased magazine size for both player weapons, allowing for extended engagement.
- Players will now switch weapons by pressing the '1' key, applicable during both combat and exploration.
- Enhanced enemy speed and attack animations for a more dynamic combat experience.

**Visual & Animation Updates:**

- Improved weapon animations for smoother and more immersive interactions.
- Added the ability to toggle camera head bobbing in-game by pressing the '5' key. This setting resets at the start of each session.
- Now have access to a help screen during the pause menu, featuring controls, gameplay tips, and a summary of key mechanics.

**Audio Fixes:**

- Addressed several audio issues for a more polished sound design, including new rifle reloading sounds.

**Bug Fixes:**

- Fixed an issue that allowed players to switch weapons while reloading.

- Players can no longer reload when the magazine is already full.

This update aims to provide a smoother and more engaging experience for all players. Thank you for your support and feedback! I will continue refining and enhancing the game to ensure the best experience possible.
